meta.audit_target: Flask pagination normalization and data consistency

identified_issues.description: Frontend and proxy both append page parameter, causing unpredictable results
identified_issues.risk: Different environments return different pages; pagination links become inconsistent
identified_issues.fix_applied: Pick first valid value, audit others in normalization trail

identified_issues.description: Client submits negative or zero page value
identified_issues.risk: Paginate() may produce invalid links or raise

identified_issues.description: Large page numbers cause expensive OFFSET database scans
identified_issues.risk: SQLAlchemy generates large OFFSET query, wasting resources
identified_issues.performance_impact: Without fix: O(n) database scan. With fix: O(1) bounds check

identified_issues.description: Upstream encodes page as array-like parameter
identified_issues.risk: Flask parser silently drops page[], backend falls back to default page=1
identified_issues.fix_applied: Map first valid integer from page[] to page

identified_issues.description: Mobile/legacy client uses offset/limit instead of page/per_page
identified_issues.risk: Backend only supports page/per_page, ignores offset/limit
identified_issues.fix_applied: Normalize offset/limit to page/per_page: page = offset/limit + 1

identified_issues.description: Posts with identical timestamps break stable pagination
identified_issues.example: Multiple posts created at same microsecond
identified_issues.risk: Refreshing same page shows different results; duplicates/gaps on boundaries
identified_issues.observed_result: Refreshing page 2 may show different posts or duplicates from page 1
identified_issues.fix_applied: Add secondary deterministic sort key: ORDER BY timestamp DESC, id DESC
identified_issues.test_coverage: Models test suite validates deterministic ordering

identified_issues.description: CDN caches user-dependent paginated URL and serves to different user
identified_issues.example: User alice's followed posts cached at /explore?page=2, served to user bob
identified_issues.risk: Data leakage - cross-user visibility of personalized feeds
identified_issues.observed_result: User can see another user's personalized feed (privacy violation)
identified_issues.fix_applied: Mark user-dependent routes with Cache-Control: private, no-cache, no-store
identified_issues.deployment: Routes like /user/<username>, /explore (when user-dependent) must use private cache

identified_issues.description: Server template generates page=4, SPA router appends page=5
identified_issues.fix_applied: Normalize to first valid integer page=4

identified_issues.description: Client visits route without page parameter
identified_issues.risk: Direct indexing into request.args can raise
identified_issues.fix_applied: Always fallback to page=1, generate pagination links with explicit page
Treat invalid as page=1, apply per_page=50

identified_issues.risk: Triggers large OFFSET/LIMIT queries; DoS vector

identified_issues.description: Client uses parameter aliases (p, size) not recognized by backend
identified_issues.risk: Backend drops parameters, falls back to defaults

features: Deterministic ordering with secondary sort keys
User feed isolation with proper caching
Automatic pagination parameter normalization on all routes
Full normalization audit in API responses

expected_outcomes: ✓ All duplicate parameters detected and consolidated
✓ Malformed parameters safely handled with defaults
✓ Parameter aliases mapped to canonical names
✓ Array-like encoding converted to standard format
✓ Canonical URLs generated with single page parameter

deployment_checklist.item: Parameter normalization in all paginated routes
Cache control headers for user-dependent routes

deployment_checklist.details: Comprehensive README with architecture and deployment guide

performance_metrics.cache_efficiency: Canonical URLs eliminate duplicate cache entries
performance_metrics.database_optimization: Composite indices (timestamp, id) enable efficient pagination
performance_metrics.bounds_protection: O(1) OFFSET bound checking prevents DoS

security_considerations.threat: Denial of Service via excessive OFFSET

security_considerations.mitigation: All parameters parsed as integers only
Canonical URL generation and Vary header

next_steps: Verify cache headers on user-dependent routes
Add to monitoring/alerting for pagination anomalies
Load test with concurrent requests to verify thread-safety
Benchmark database queries with large datasets
